name: Milliman IntelliScript (prescription history)
tip: Life and health insurers can buy a record of the prescriptions you have filled. You can ask for your free copy on the page, or call 877-211-4816, or write to Milliman IntelliScript, P.O. Box 2223, Brookfield, WI 53008. They only have a file if you applied for individual life or health insurance. If you never did, tap NOT LISTED.

name: Eyeota (ad targeting by email)
tip: Eyeota sells ad targeting data linked to your email address. On the page enter your email and tick the box asking them not to use your email for ad targeting or profiling, then submit. Then tap MARK AS SENT. If you would rather not, tap NOT LISTED.

name: Outlogic (phone location data, was X-Mode)
tip: Outlogic sells location data collected from phone apps and finds you by the advertising ID on your phone. Before you send the email, open Settings, Security and privacy, More privacy settings, Ads. If your advertising ID shows there, copy it into the email above your name. Ask for deletion: it works for any state. Send the email first, then delete the ID using the Android advertising ID row. You can also call 866-346-9602. If they say they have no data on you, tap NOT LISTED.

name: Android phone: delete your advertising ID
tip: Do this on your phone. Apps use a hidden advertising ID to follow you between apps and sell where you go. Open Settings, tap Security and privacy, More privacy settings, Ads, then tap Delete advertising ID and confirm. If you do not see Delete, tap Reset advertising ID instead. Menus differ by phone, so you can also type Ads in the Settings search box. If you plan to email Outlogic, do that first. Then tap MARK AS DONE.

name: PublicRecordsNow
tip: Search your name and state, open your listing, then look for the removal or privacy link at the bottom of the page. Fill in your name and email and tap the link they email you. Removal takes about a week. If you cannot find the link, or nothing there is you, tap NOT LISTED.

name: BackgroundAlert
tip: Scroll to the bottom and tap Remove My Info. Enter your name and state, find your record and tap That is me, enter your email and tap the link they send. It then asks how to verify you: pick the easiest choice. If it asks for a photo of your ID, stop and tell me. Save your case number. If nothing there is you, tap NOT LISTED.

name: VoterRecords.com (voter lists)
tip: Texas voter registration is public, and this site republishes it. Search your name, open your listing, scroll to the bottom and use the record opt-out. They may take off your address, phone and email even if the voting record itself stays. If nothing there is you, tap NOT LISTED.

name: Addresses.com (Intelius site)
tip: Addresses.com is run by Intelius and has no removal page of its own. If you already did the Intelius row, it should clear in a few weeks. If your listing is still there, use this Intelius privacy page and choose to delete your information. If nothing there is you, tap NOT LISTED.
